positions.name: BattleKart Nantes
positions.evidence: Own centre page: 'Le centre BattleKart Nantes est a l'etage d'Eurobowl' (9 avenue Simone Veil); embedded coords 47.189701,-1.487024 lie 35 m from the Eurobowl building (OSM way/1177180995, leisure=bowling_alley, ~4100 m2). Position = Eurobowl building centroid. House number 9 is not in OSM (search only matched street way/765167644).

positions.name: BattleKart Paris-Nord-Villepinte
positions.evidence: Own centre page embeds 48.975883,2.516462 and says the centre is in a 'Parc d'exposition' (ZAC Paris Nord 2, no street number; operator SAS Kart City 2). Reverse geocode only gives a bridge on Allee des Impressionnistes; the point lies in an OSM landuse=construction area next to the Viparis parking E1 / Waterside buildings; no OSM building or object for the venue. Position is the operator's own pin, not verified against a building.

positions.name: BattleKart Valenciennes
positions.evidence: Own page: 'Le nouveau spot loisirs ... a la Cite des Congres de Valenciennes (Anzin)', 1 Esplanade des Rives Creatives de l'Escaut (opened 14 Feb 2026). Embedded coords 50.37579,3.522342 fall inside OSM building way/538962656 'Cite des Congres' (building=public). Address not in Nominatim.

positions.name: SpeedPark Angers Beaucouze
positions.evidence: Own page: 'Le SpeedPark se trouve au sein du centre commercial ATOLL', Ecoparc du Buisson, 49073 Beaucouze (no street number). OSM node/11915648137 leisure=sports_centre name 'Speed Park' on Rue Eugene Vallin in L'Atoll (Nominatim search 'Speed Park, Beaucouze'; reverse at the node returns the same object).

positions.name: SpeedPark Bordeaux
positions.evidence: Own page address: Av. du 7eme art, 33140 Villenave-d'Ornon (complex Ortalissa). OSM relation/19641804 type=building name 'Ortalissa' (website ortalissa.fr), members ways 1432379519 and 1432379520 (new leisure/retail buildings at 5 Avenue du 7eme Art). Position = between the two member buildings; which hall holds the kart track is not stated.

positions.name: SpeedPark Claye-Souilly
positions.evidence: Own page: 3 rue Robert Schuman, 77410 Claye-Souilly (OSM spells it Rue Robert Schumann); its map embed is an address query only. No house number 3 and no SpeedPark object in OSM; nearest address object is Burger King at 5 Rue Robert Schumann (node/12367901901, not used as ref). Position is on the Rue Robert Schumann segment way/918594716 next to no. 5 (~1.4 km W of the old town-centroid position). Building not identifiable.

positions.name: BattleKart Antwerpen
positions.evidence: Own page: Waagnatie - Expo & Events, Rijnkaai 150; embedded coords 51.233795,4.401996. Reverse geocode returns OSM node/11104576517 named 'battle kart' (mis-tagged amenity=car_rental) on Rijnkaai, inside the Rijnkaai event-hall building way/43071539.

positions.name: BattleKart Liege-Verlaine
positions.evidence: Own page: Grand Route 126, 4537 Verlaine; embedded coords 50.610531,5.318106. OSM has Grand Route 122/124/129/133/135 but no 126 and no BattleKart object; reverse gives building no. 129 (different number, not used). Largest nearby building is unnumbered way/933214833 (~1400 m2, 43 m SW) - plausible hall but unverified. Position = operator's own pin.

positions.name: John Martin's Karting Namur (JM Karting Floreffe)
positions.evidence: Own Namur page: Rue de Saint-Gobain 1, 5150 Floreffe, embedded map lat 50.435378 lng 4.740038. OSM node/11085569991 'JMKarting' (leisure=amusement_arcade) 42 m from that pin, at the Glacerie de Franiere industrial building (way/732454751). The contact-page coords used before (50.433687,4.743143) are ~300 m off.

positions.name: Circuito del Sele
positions.evidence: Own contact page: Via Fosso Pioppo (map query 'Via fosso pioppo 15'), 84091 Battipaglia. OSM way/107801416 leisure=sports_centre 'Circuit Sele' on Via Fosso Pioppo, containing closed raceway loop way/1235262406 (~1.85 km). Previous position (40.61068,14.96395) was ~1.4 km away on a street segment. OSM gives postcode 84092 there.

positions.name: 7 Laghi Kart - Circuito Internazionale (Castelletto Circuit)
positions.evidence: Own site: SP1 6/A Castelletto di Branduzzo (PV); its contact-page Google embed is centred on 45.0632,9.0904 for place '7 Laghi Kart'. OSM way/416255369 leisure=track name 'Circuito Internazionale 7 laghi' (with Pit Lane/Park Fermee raceways way/416255372, way/416255371) in Castelletto di Branduzzo; reverse at its centre returns raceway way/80905675 on the SP Bressana-Salice Terme. Not the Motodromo Castelletto (relation/14098605, ~0.7 km NE).

positions.name: Space Game Val Camonica - Kart (ex Planet Kart)
positions.evidence: Own contact page: Via Saletti 20, Zona Industriale, 25050 Pian Camuno; Google embed place 'Planet Kart' at 45.8457679,10.1377296. That pin sits 3 m from the edge of OSM industrial building way/373544910 (~7550 m2, the only large building at the pin; next building 50 m away). Building has no name/address tags in OSM. Via Saletti is not in Nominatim (reverse gives way/388254624, locality Beata).

positions.name: Torino Kart Indoor
positions.evidence: Own homepage Google Maps link: ll=45.114241,7.672981, q='Via Enrico Fermi, 11 10148 Torino TO'. Real address: Via Enrico Fermi 11, 10148 Torino (Madonna di Campagna); '10048' in the site footer is a typo, not Vinovo. The pin lies inside OSM industrial building way/1535838475 (~9170 m2, mapped 2026). The OSM address node 'Via Enrico Fermi 11' (node/4733915803, 10148) is ~85 m SE of the pin.

positions.name: SKindoor - Sardinia Kart Indoor
positions.evidence: Own site gives only 'Monastir (CA)'. OSM building way/249471138 named 'Kartodromo SKindoor' (found via Overpass name~Kart); reverse at it returns Monastir 09023. About 4 km S of the Monastir centroid used before and ~3.3 km W of SestuGO!.

positions.name: Kartring Oberberg (Oberbergischer Go-Kart-Ring Hahn-Wildbergerhuette)
positions.evidence: Own Anfahrt page: Google embed place 'Auf dem Menn, 51580 Reichshof' plus route target 50.9701274,7.764027. OSM node/345882535 leisure=sports_centre 'Kartbahn Oberberg' (reverse: Auf dem Menn 14, Hahn, Reichshof) next to raceway way/68531005 'Kartbahn'. Address should read Auf dem Menn (14), 51580 Reichshof, not Halbhustener Weg.

positions.name: VM Kart Racing
positions.evidence: Own site: Johann-Reiss-Strasse 1, D-79541 Loerrach-Brombach (house number not in OSM). OSM way/88300368 leisure=sports_centre name 'Kart Racing' (addr Alte Strasse 3, 79541 Loerrach) lies ~160 m from the Johann-Reiss-Strasse segment centre; it is the only kart object there. Its address tags differ from the site (Alte Strasse 3 vs Johann-Reiss-Strasse 1) - likely corner plot/entrance difference; flag if strict.

positions.name: Motokary Masarykuv okruh (CREDITAS Autodrom Brno)
positions.evidence: Own page: kart track 423 m long, a few tens of metres from the big circuit, inside the Masarykuv okruh 201 complex; the page links a mapy.cz panorama at 49.2027873,16.4487208. Reverse there returns OSM way/184267672 highway=raceway sport=motor, a closed loop of 422 m (matches 423 m) - this is the kart track, not the GP circuit way/8585805.

positions.name: Gokartcentralen Kungalv
positions.evidence: Own site: Arntorpsgatan 22, 442 45 Kungalv (map embeds are address queries only, no coordinates). OSM has no house numbers on Arntorpsgatan and no kart/raceway object; several unnamed 1200-1900 m2 buildings along the street, none identifiable. Position unchanged (street way/230405371, postcode 442 45).

positions.name: Scandinavian Kartway
positions.evidence: Own site: Nennesmovagen 21, 334 33 Anderstorp; no coordinates on home/kontakt pages. OSM map 13.605-13.625 / 57.262-57.274 has the Anderstorp Raceway objects but no kart track, raceway or house number 21 on Nennesmovagen. Position unchanged (street way/1274626538).

positions.name: GoKartCity Helsingborg
positions.evidence: Own page: Sjogatan 5, 25225 Helsingborg; the page's JSON-LD coordinates are Malmo's (55.58,13.02), not Helsingborg. OSM has only Sjogatan 1 (node/4760534055, at the IKEA Sockerbruket building) and no no. 5 or kart object. Position unchanged (Sjogatan segment way/376569001, postcode 252 25).

positions.name: Gokarthallen Halmstad
positions.evidence: Own site says only 'Slottsmollan, 302 31 HALMSTAD', 'Magasinet pa Slottsmollan', on 'Slottsmollans Industriomrade ... precis vid norra infarten fran E6' - no street number (the 'Slottsmollan 10' in D09 is not on the site). Nominatim finds neither Slottsmollan in Halmstad nor the venue; OSM map around the postcode centroid shows no kart object. Position unchanged (postcode centroid) - needs manual placement.

battlekart_new.name: BattleKart Bispingen
battlekart_new.evidence: Own page: Gaussscher Bogen 8, 29646 Bispingen; embedded 53.098354,9.982157. Nominatim search and reverse both return OSM node/8331688445 'Battle-Kart' (leisure=sports_centre, sport=karting, website bispingen.battlekart.com). Separate from existing way/856436751.

battlekart_new.name: BattleKart Köln
battlekart_new.evidence: Own page: Butzweilerstrasse 35-39, Motorworld 4-Takt Hangar, 50829 Koeln. OSM way/38446078 is the building '4-Takt-Hangar' (Motorworld Koeln-Rheinland, addr 35-39) - Nominatim search hit. BattleKart's embedded pin (50.981995,6.899971) is ~60 m NW of the hangar over Bertha-Sander-Strasse housing, so the hangar position is used. ~700 m from existing node/3761972790.

battlekart_new.name: BattleKart Dankern
battlekart_new.evidence: Own page: Am Flugplatz 1, 49733 Haren (Ems), ~1 km walk from Ferienzentrum Schloss Dankern; embedded 52.803493,7.163298. In OSM that address belongs to the Emslandring Dankern objects (way/92468697 = existing entry, way/683064337 Crossbahn); the BattleKart hall (opened 2023) is not mapped - the pin lies ~30 m W of the Crossbahn and ~105 m NW of the Emslandring centre. ref left null to avoid reusing the existing entry's id; complex fallback would be way/92468697.

nantes.evidence: City Kart's own page (city-kart.fr/karting-indoor-de-nantes/) is live, sells 2026/2027 course dates and describes its own 500 m indoor petrol-kart track (17 Sodikart SR5 270cc, FFSA-approved) 'situe sur la Zone de Loisirs du Cineville, proche du Laser Game Evolution et de l'Eurobowl'. BattleKart Nantes is upstairs in the Eurobowl building (way/1177180995). OSM node/5607946169 'City Kart' (sport=karting) is at 47.19020,-1.48975, ~250 m W of Eurobowl. Two distinct operating venues; neither replaced the other.
